uncited: **Partitioning:** Divide the 3D scene bounding box into $K$ disjoint, non-overlapping spatial regions.
**Broadcast:** Collect the $(\mathbf{c}_i, \sigma_i)$ pairs from all GPUs.
**Loss Computation:** Compute the photometric loss and the distortion loss $\mathcal{L}_{dist}$ on each GPU.
**Backward Pass (Local Gradient):** Compute gradients for the local NeRF parameters $\theta_k$ and the global per-camera embeddings locally on each GPU.
**Parameter Update:** Update the local parameters $\theta_k$ locally on each GPU.
